scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.start: node scripts/prepare-env.cjs prod && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.start:dev: node scripts/prepare-env.cjs dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.app:build: npm run sync:config && cd packages/frontend && npm install && npm run build && npx cap sync android
